question: When can I retire with an unreduced pension?

nuggets.text: A police officer or firefighter hired after October 1996 may retire voluntarily after 25 years of service, with 60 days' written notice.
nuggets.quote: who completes 25 years of service, and gives at least 60 days written advanced notice to his department stating his intention to retire

notes: Police and firefighters only; the teachers' optional retirement sections (§ 38-2021.01 et seq.) are not quoted here.
